items.statement: CO-dependent branching and the absence of direct cyclization have a quantitative molecular explanation.
items.expected: Use the established channels to explain lactone versus diene and why CO availability changes the competition, including inhibition at excessive CO as a qualified speciation explanation. This block scores CO-dependent product branching supported by an additional competing-channel/speciation comparison; repeating the three high direct-route energies or the carbonylative profile earns no additional credit. As a consistency condition, attribute direct-route failure to energetics/coordination and strained intermediate formation, not simply a universally higher metallo-ene local barrier. Do not infer a numerical yield or rate from unbalanced profile heights; no calculations on other substrates are hidden requirements.
